Yes it has been very helpful to mark htf S/D and then watching an aggressive move to that level. You can often see the flag limit before entering the zone, and as Harry's article points out you can even trade it! And once the limit is engulfed you can look to ride that aggressive move (POLE) back to the origin. Given the right PA at the origin even take it back the other way creating the COAST to COAST ride. Something I haven't done yet, but is how I see it play out

Okay for illustrative purposes I will show what I am talking about.

There is an aggressive move lower, it actually goes below the previous days low, but it is a potential s/d from HTF.

Waiting patiently you see the red box flag limit, knowing this is an obstacle price has to pass. It engulfs the zone and the green box is the origin D that caused the engulf. Look to get long and ride the move up as marked by the red dashed line.

Price now makes an aggressive move up to a previous FO area and previous days highs. Price is Stalling. There are other D that could have been marked but my red box is the one that finally got engulfed and the origin was a FAKEOUT marked by the green box. Look to enter short. Nice FTR target at the bottom.

Why did I buy gold? - Buy @ DBR / Trapped Sellers / FTR

What trouble may lie ahead? How will I know if I'm onto a real winner?

If it's a loser, how will I know? What would be my best escape? - If price engulf south of the FTR level (the entry price) it would be a sign it a can do further low. - Best escape would be when price is back to bail our BE after engulf

How do I make sure I can't lose? - If entry be on pip accuracy, then in case of level be broken price will re-test the price before continue downward. this would be the exit at bail out. The conclusion is that only accurate entry will provide better odd for bail out if needed.
